correctness.rationale: Verified exact radial monomial moment beta_r(k)=sum_(v<=2r) binomial(2r,v)Gamma(k+1+v/2) and asymptotic Gamma(k+r+1)(1+O(k^-1/2)). A term a_(j,h) z^h f^(j) integrated n times has normalized band shift n+h-j and leading k^{-(n+m-ell-j-h)/2} with coefficient a. The maximal j+h=D layer gives finite Laurent polynomial P(e^{i theta})=e^{i(n+D)theta}Q(e^{-2i theta}) and k^{-delta/2} weight. Lower layers have column O(k^{-delta/2-1/2}); finite-column truncations give singular tail o(t^{-2/delta}). Reconstructed weighted-band Weyl lemma via block-rescaled closed-walk trace moments, Fourier zero mode, polynomial approximation and controlled boundary/low/high tails. Ky Fan counting perturbations, monotone inversion and harmonic sum give s_k~C^{delta/2}k^{-delta/2}, Schatten iff p>2/delta and critical residue C. The I^3(zf+f′) two-band weights and C=4/pi checked independently.
